shortlist.label: Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: EBV-positive, CD138-positive, and CD56-positive, consistent with NK/T-cell lymphoma

shortlist.label: Nasal-type T-cell lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Similar clinical presentation and immunophenotypic features, including CD56 positivity

shortlist.label: Sinonasal natural killer cell lymphoma with CD138 expression
shortlist.why_kept: Matches the case's CD138 and CD56 positivity, and EBV association

shortlist.label: Nasal lymphoma with NK-cell markers
shortlist.why_kept: Shares NK-cell markers and clinical presentation with the case

shortlist.label: Sinonasal lymphoma with features intermediate between NK-cell and T-cell lymphoma

raw.rationale: The presence of a large polypoid mass obstructing the left nasal cavity, CD138 and CD56 positivity, and EBV positivity are consistent with Nasal Type NK/T-cell Lymphoma. The lack of CD20 and PAX5 expression also supports this diagnosis, as these markers are typically negative in NK/T-cell lymphomas.

rejected.label: Extranodal Natural Killer/T-cell Lymphoma
rejected.why: While this is a broader category that includes Nasal Type NK/T-cell Lymphoma, the specific involvement of the nasal cavity and the presence of EBV positivity make Nasal Type NK/T-cell Lymphoma a more specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Plasmablastic Lymphoma
rejected.why: This type of lymphoma is typically CD20 positive and often expresses other B-cell markers, which are not present in this case.

rejected.label: Burkitt Lymphoma
rejected.why: Burkitt Lymphoma is typically characterized by a translocation involving the MYC gene, but it is usually CD20 positive and has a different immunophenotypic profile than the one described.

rejected.label: Diffuse Large B-cell Lymphoma
rejected.why: This type of lymphoma is typically CD20 positive and often expresses other B-cell markers, which are not present in this case.
